note: Ceilings for scripts/app-bundle-budget.mjs. Uncompressed bytes, unioned client chunks per route prefix, measured from a real `next build`. Raising a ceiling is allowed and is meant to be an argument: put what it bought in `why`, in the SAME commit that spends it. Re-measure with `npm run build && node scripts/app-bundle-budget.mjs --record`.

admin.why: Recorded at the commit that introduced this gate: 9.13 MB uncompressed, the union of the client chunks across all 75 routes under the /admin prefix, dominated by the admin shell every one of them shares. Headroom is 512 KB (~5%) — roughly one substantial new screen, and deliberately not generous, because growth in a UNION means the SHARED shell grew and that is the thing worth being asked about. This is a prefix total, i.e. an upper bound on any single route, not a first-load number. Raised 2026-09-24 for Talent Agenda V2 (Today/Calendar/Attention, Confirm-transfer CTA, TradeSections i18n). Raised again 2026-09-24 evening AUTO-RUN Wave C (+7885 B ceiling; CI was +3.7 KB over prior ceiling). Raised 2026-09-25 for front-door QA solo dock (omit platform brand + ES guest ack + empty Home rail; CI was +81 B over prior ceiling, +256 B headroom). Raised 2026-09-25 for jor-day #2270 (Clients load + seller Actions wiring + Collect deposit / Reschedule / remint on booking record; CI was +2.4 KB over prior ceiling; +256 B headroom). Raised 2026-09-25 for booking-sheet Ask/Chat→Messages handoff (pending offering selection + guest contact, `tulala:ask-question` dock, who-step Chat now; CI +397 B, +256 B headroom). Raised again 2026-09-25 after merge-with-main: combined admin graph CI +1229 B (~1.2 KB) over jor-day ceiling; ceiling→10126388 (measured 10124340 + 2048 B headroom) for booking-sheet chat CTA on tip 1615c83d1. Raised 2026-09-25 for services_catalog flexibility #2283 (layouts/nav/selection/inspector panels; CI was +8.3 KB over prior ceiling; +256 B headroom). Raised again 2026-09-25 for services_catalog flexibility #2283 tip (CI still +1.2 KB over after first raise; +512 B headroom).

pos.why: 8.92 MB uncompressed for the register route's client graph. Headroom is 256 KB, half of admin's, on purpose: this is the tablet-on-venue-wifi surface, and the five POS modes the blueprints specify are supposed to SPLIT this bundle rather than add to it. A mode landing here should show up as a ceiling argument, not as slack already waiting.
